title: 串联 RLC 对 3 次谐波谐振
statement: 求电流的基波分量、3 次谐波分量和有效值。再求电容电压的有效值和电路吸收的平均功率。

questions.ask: 基波电流 İ_1 的初相 = ?
3 次谐波电流有效值 I_3 = ?
questions.explain: 3ωL = 15 Ω，1/(3ωC) = 15 Ω，电路对 3 次谐波**串联谐振**，Z_3 = R = 10 Ω，I_3 = 30/10 = 3 A——比基波电流还大。

questions.ask: 电路吸收的平均功率 P = ?

hints: 对每一次谐波重新计算电抗：感抗乘以 k，容抗除以 k。
算出 3ωL 和 1/(3ωC) 之后比较一下——有什么特别的？
有效值和功率都按“各次谐波分别算、平方和/求和”合成，不要把不同频率的相量相加。

en.title: Series RLC resonant at the 3rd harmonic
statement: R = 10 Ω, L = 5 mH and C = 22.22 µF in series are driven by v_s = 100√2 cos(1000t) + 30√2 cos(3000t) V.
Find the fundamental and 3rd-harmonic components and the rms value of the current. Then find the rms capacitor voltage and the average power absorbed.
hints: Recompute the reactances for every harmonic: inductive reactance times k, capacitive reactance divided by k.
Combine rms values and powers harmonic by harmonic (sum of squares / plain sum); never add phasors of different frequencies.
solution: **2. 3rd harmonic** (3ω = 3000 rad/s): 3ωL = 15 Ω, 1/(3ωC) = 15 Ω, X_3 = 0: **series resonance** at the 3rd harmonic, Z_3 = 10 Ω, İ_3 = 30∠0°/10 = **3∠0° A**.
**3. Current:** i = 2.425√2 cos(1000t + 75.96°) + 3√2 cos(3000t) A, I = √(2.425² + 3²) = **3.858 A**. The 3rd-harmonic voltage is only 30 % of the fundamental, yet its current is larger.
**5. Power:** P = I²R = **148.8 W** (58.82 W fundamental + 90 W 3rd harmonic).

questions.ask: rms value of the fundamental current, I_1 = ?
Initial phase of the fundamental current İ_1 = ?
rms value of the 3rd-harmonic current, I_3 = ?
questions.explain: 3ωL = 15 Ω and 1/(3ωC) = 15 Ω: the circuit is in **series resonance** at the 3rd harmonic, Z_3 = R = 10 Ω, I_3 = 30/10 = 3 A — larger than the fundamental current.
V_C1 = 2.425 × 45 = 109.1 V, V_C3 = 3 × 15 = 45 V, V_C = √(109.1² + 45²) = 118.1 V — higher than the source's rms voltage √(100² + 30²) = 104.4 V.

questions.ask: Average power absorbed by the circuit, P = ?
questions.explain: P = I²R = (2.425² + 3²) × 10 = 148.8 W, of which 90 W is at the 3rd harmonic.
